question: What connects lowerer scratch allocation, CPU writes, commit and selected tiled replay destinations, and where does safe reclaim remain unproved?

scope.qualification: Static conditional masks/strides and selected producer/decoder join; no actual runtime allocator row, root delivery, physical extent or safe reclamation proof.

dependencies.use: Owns scratch units, completion domains and allocator ownership qualifications.
Owns dirty, mode, cache/code and persistent helper boundaries.
Owns retained dirty/allocator readers and alias limitations.
Owns saved restoration, list finalization, failure and command-segment exits.
Owns worker participation, lifecycle observers and retirement qualifications.

allocatorAndLifetime.routes: B618 mode1 allocated upward with wrap/generation guards; success updated a pool cursor before B158. B158 compared endpoint/modulo4 generation with B+4, B=word(G2A90), and could stop through CBB8 independently of progress. A6848 allocated downward and rejected below G30+164. selectedTileDestination.localEmission: V: At A3048 entry, qV=U(r6*r9)>>2 and qI=r7 when r8&4, otherwise U(r7+1)>>1. At caller BF8,k=retained caller r24,r8=1 and r7=6*k, so qI=3*k dwords=12*k bytes; indexed J carries0x40000000 and R gains no0x0800. Primitive r4 is independent. Vertex B818(qV,16) at0x826A3308 precedes index B818(qI,16) at0x826A331C even when the first returns0. Either null takes the3544 failure path:publish current cursor, zero output cells, return FFFFFFFF8007000E without rollback. Success emits13 common words ending D=C+0x34, then14 tiled words or5 untiled words:27/18 new words and pending end C+0x6C/C+0x48. Tiled growth occurs exactly when U(E+16)>word(L+0xC); C170 return is used without a root failure-bit/null recheck. Success stages G+0x3484/+0x3488/+0x348C/+0x3490/+0x3494 and returned pointers, reloads G+0x18 then ORs1, and returns0. It does not locally publish the pending suffix cursor to G+0x30; earlier helper/allocator publications remain real.

rectangleProducer.guestPackets: V: Stores0x826A34F8/34FC/3500 emit C0015A01,decimal26,encoded(E+4)|1;0x826A3504/350C emit C0004601,decimal25. The encoded operand is U(((E+4)&0x1FFFFFFE)+(((((U(E+4)>>20)&0xFFF)+0x200)&0x1000)))|1. These are the ordered producer/reset event packets, not CPU halfword stores.
rectangleProducer.sdkCounterpart: V: SDK xenos.h identifies opcode0x5A as EVENT_WRITE_EXT,initiator26 SCREEN_EXT_RPT,opcode0x46 EVENT_WRITE and initiator25 SCREEN_EXT_INIT. Both emitted headers are predicated:dispatcher skips payload when(bin_select&bin_mask)==0. A reached EXT handler writes the event register and six swapped u16 values to TranslatePhysical(address&~3), requiring lowbits1/k8in16. Field order is minX,maxX,minY,maxY,minZ,maxZ at E+0x4/+0x6/+0x8/+0xA/+0xC/+0xE if the physical alias is valid. The pinned SDK deliberately writes fixed[0,1024,0,1024,0,1], not draw-measured hardware extents. Six elements use the x86-64 ascending scalar residual copy. The subsequent reached count1 EVENT_WRITE writes the initiator register and no memory payload locally.
rectangleProducer.qualification: I: Guest packet identity/order and this SDK source counterpart do not prove execution on the selected native/drop route, actual predicate, E physical alias, completed payload visibility, retail hardware values or same-generation worker consumption. Source statement order is not atomic visibility. An exact rectangle observer must join executed packet/predicate/translated destination/completed bytes to L/E/D/chunk generation.

Five interval calls0x82510C24/38/44/68/88 are fallback-only. No local success-arm branch abandons that commit between fills, but descendants can fail to return/unwind/reenter or modify aliases. Later indirect callbacks at0x82510D80/94 can loop0x82510D9C->0x82510A90, reusing the same frame for another begin.
callerActivation.argumentsAndWrites: V/I: BF8 r3=G=word(owner+0xBC),r4/r5=word(record+0x38)/word(record+0x30),r6=word(record+0x10),r7=6*r24,r8=1,r9=36,r10=F+0x68,stack F+0x54=F+0x64. Vertex helper writes144*low16(F+0x60) bytes; count/source/output/ABI retention is required. Index leaf writes12*r24 bytes:for j,u=U(0x20000+j*0x40004),BE32[u-0x1FFFF,u,u+3]. The usual six-u16 pattern requires4*j+3<=65535; arbitrary counts retain packed32 carry behavior. callerActivation.tokenRoute: I: Scope an exact host activation at825107A0, but allocate a fresh never-reused nonzero occurrence token for every actual BF8 invocation. Carry that explicit record through BFC and successful CE0, claim once before staging reads/copy, verify/close at CE4, and explicitly abandon unmatched records on proved return/unwind. Preserve suspended occurrences across nested activations and guest-context migration. A tokenless/latest G/SP/PC/staging lookup is unsound both after frame reuse and after another iteration in one activation. An asynchronous event must carry its origin token or reject; lost/nonlocal context association cannot borrow a newer scope.

The two82512608 no-call fill intervals are locally smaller, but accepted windows do not establish complete outer entry/exit/repetition/unwind association. All three remain legacy for history recycling until their own activation contracts close; no fresh sink census was performed.

selectedConsumerBoundary.qualification: Conditional static contracts; no natural occurrence, complete dirty-entry equivalence or runtime consume admission established.
selectedConsumerBoundary.commitLeaf: A2FF0 loads BE32[G+3484] into zero-extended full64 r11, stores that value to BE32[G+30], preserves full incoming r3, and returns. It copies/frees no geometry.
selectedConsumerBoundary.occurrenceBoundary: The successful BF8/BFC fill/CE0/CE4 route requires a fresh occurrence within its enclosing activation, including loop reuse; explicit origin association closes observer history only, not allocation or GPU retirement.
selectedConsumerBoundary.consumerBoundary: The existing native particle path copies owned geometry into recipes and retains uploads through an actual host queue fence, but its held root is not joined to the observer occurrence as a durable reservation.
selectedConsumerBoundary.smallestConsumeCut: Conditional exact-token substitution of the A2FF0 leaf can preserve Original lowerer/helper/fill execution. It does not admit dirty A3048 or BeginVertices. Broader omission requires independent complete entry effects and durable occurrence-to-copy/submission/fence ownership.
selectedConsumerBoundary.rectangleBoundary: Local E+0 and packet emission do not prove actual predicated extent production, translated physical alias, completed halfwords, same-generation worker use or safe reclaim.
selectedConsumerBoundary.independentEntry: The current observer freezes Entry prediction before Original and compares PreTake separately. Its clean tiled CPU projection has27words/108bytes, while completeEntryExact and consumeEligible remain false. Positive scratch projection does not prove dirty-helper architectural effects, rectangle execution, allocation generations or consume authority.
selectedConsumerBoundary.deviceProvenance: The occurrence initializes incarnation0 with incarnationKnown=false. The incarnationAuthority section bounds the examined device, allocator, registration and observer candidates; native held-root device/SP/staging association is separate from backing authority.
selectedConsumerBoundary.durableReceipt: A broader consumed begin requires pre-effect reservation of exact occurrence, canonical backing generations, immutable copy/submission capacity and strong service/dispatcher/ledger ownership; commit must join the actual retained recipe, upload lease/submission and last-use host fence. Observer evidence vectors do not supply that transfer.
selectedConsumerBoundary.conditionalLeaf: Only a successfully CE0-claimed BF8/BFC occurrence may substitute the raw A2FF0 leaf after preserving exactly-one native commit callback and existing copy/build order. Revalidate actual pending-word read and cursor-word write mappings before mutation; load pending first, zero-extend fullr11, store its low32, preserve full incomingr3 and all remaining context/LR. Refused or unknown leaf-only calls execute Original once. This does not recover a failed broader consumed begin.
selectedConsumerBoundary.remainingGate: Actual token association/device incarnation, independent complete dirty entry/helper result, all-reader/physical alias lifetime, selected rectangle event/worker identity and first overlap/release remain qualified. No probe class-starvation or zero-comparison result selects a guest row.

incarnationAuthority.qualification: Bounded static rejection of the named proxies, not a complete allocator-writer census or observed recycling. No inspected value supplies authoritative device-allocation or scratch-reservation incarnation at activation construction and both commit checkpoints. Unknown remains distinct from a match.
incarnationAuthority.method: Serial foreground tools/run-headless.ps1 -ReadOnly identified eight exact entries and read731 selected words. All matched the supported flat image;197 memory operands,134 branch destinations and73 immediate operands matched narrow generated interpretation. Mapped SHA256 remained389EB006B1DCDE90C5DE775C92D67C18542B8FD9BD39845574206D4B213E9B13, with470 differing bytes in60 ranges confined to [0x827F3F50,0x827F4280), outside selected words. Thunk-truncated analyzed bodies were not repaired. Reproduce exact words with ghidra/DumpMemoryWords.java and REREVVED_WORD_RADIUS=0; use ghidra/DumpFunctionNeighborhoodBatch.java for exact-entry metadata.
incarnationAuthority.leafAndOrigin: A2FF0 writes only BE32[G+0x30] from the prior BE32[G+0x3484] load; G allocation lifetime is distinct from the pending command and H_v/H_i backing. At825107A0 entry r3 is owner O, not G. A checked BE32[O+0xBC] can select G, but the actual BF8 and CE0 calls reload that field; CE0 reload is82510CDC. A0 opens an activation; the current observer constructs each occurrence at BF8, not A0. Preserve the full owner/context and explicit occurrence; compare actual CE0 r3 to carried G and carry that identity through CE4. Repeated frame/owner/G equality is not incarnation.

poolPositionAndWrap.fields: BE32 G+0x3A44 cursor, G+0x3A48 pool epoch/protocol value, G+0x3A4C second cursor; B=BE32[G+0x2A90], with BE32[B+4] progress.
poolPositionAndWrap.operands: B618 mode1 loads G+3A48 into r5 at8269B658. Its primary arm stores end r4 to G+3A44 atB6AC. Its wrapped arm increments transient r5 atB704 and stores end to G+3A4C atB708, without storing that increment to G+3A48. B70C passes (G,end,r5) to B158. Mode2 rollover stores incremented G+3A48 atB790 and resets G+3A4C atB79C. B158 B170..B194 compares (r5-BE32[B+4])&3 and aligned progress; its wait can stop independently of progress.
poolPositionAndWrap.counterexample: The masked comparison repeats every four protocol values. Full32 G+3A48 also has no checked exhaustion here, and B118 B134..B14C restores G+30/+34/+38/+3A44/+3A48/+3A4C/+3A50 from saved G+3460..3474 rather than preserving monotonicity. C270 C374..C39C rebinds command limits/cursor state and clears G+3A44 without advancing a unique allocation ID. Position plus sampled epoch therefore has no proved no-ABA contract. Taking a fresh observer number does not repair that missing producer contract.

incarnationAuthority.otherAllocatorRoutes: B818 selects by G+34CC and manager+98 atB844/B86C. The A6848 downward arm writes G+3A44 at826A68B4 and adjusts G+34/+38 at68C4/68C8; it exposes no generation in that body. A6AB8 6ADC..6B18 applies manager+A8 minimum and invokes BE32[manager+AC] with (BE32[manager+A4],mode,&bytes,alignment), under the selected global-device+3A7C lock. Actual installed target, return/allocation identity, external backing and recycle semantics remain unbound; do not query a guessed target. Root vertex/index grants occur later atA3308/A331C, after helper/pressure effects, so an A0 sample cannot itself identify those future reservations.
incarnationAuthority.deviceAndConfigurationProxies: Accepted C8E0 teardown releases owned G+39F4/G+39F8/S2/B and can allocate equal numeric B/S2 addresses again. Pool/segment/restore reuse can occur within an unchanged configuration lifetime. B+0 completed ticket, B+4 pool progress, B+3C RPTR and S2 callback/acknowledgement words are distinct protocols. G+3C is a reference count initialized to1; G+2A88 is thread ownership. A6380 copies a global64 to G+2A80 atA63A4 and zeros G+2A8C atA63B8; no exact-change-on-recycle semantics is established for either. Publication storeA645C and final-reference CE38/CE64 heap release do not themselves supply a readable generation or successful-free/participant-quiescence proof.

hostProxies.observer: lowerer_scratch_probe.cpp:975 assigns incarnation0; the token's incarnationKnown defaults false. Domain/activation/occurrence sequences identify observed calls, with observer epoch literal1. Draw generation, dispatcher frame/sequence and execution context also name different domains.
hostProxies.ringStub: ring_stubs.cpp:74-90,151-186 and ring_stubs.h:218-226 provide publication/readiness and a bounded consume-lease drain, not a ring-stub epoch or allocation identity. Validated G remains a numeric address cache.
hostProxies.registration: guest_gpu_service.cpp:898,954 increments uint32_t ring/writeback generations on accepted registrations; locked getters are1122-1131. They are native C++ values, not guest BE words. They do not increment on each scratch recycle, can repeat on32-bit wrap or a new service object, and need their own object-domain/lifetime qualification.
hostProxies.completion: completion_probe.cpp:230,374 advances a private device-address observer epoch on init or explicit construction observation. Hook8268D2AC observes r31.u32 with r30.u32==0x5E00, not a proved allocation-return/free generation. The selected hook source/config has no matching G-free producer binding. Extent records and physical mappings are sampled base/size identities, not allocation serials.

incarnationAuthority.safeReadBoundary: Use checked nonwrapping BE32 owner/G/B/S2 reads, BE64 only for the copied G+2A80 qword, and full raw register identities without guest normalization or stores. lowerer_scratch_probe.cpp:155-189 checks access and physical contiguity, but does not retain allocation lifetime through later reads. The inspected SDK HeapAllocationInfo/PageEntry and QueryRangeAccess/QueryBaseAndSize APIs expose base, size, protection and state, not an allocation/reservation generation. Their internal metadata locks end on return; equal readable snapshots cannot exclude free/reallocate ABA. This negative is bounded to those result shapes, not the entire SDK.
incarnationAuthority.smallestDiscriminator: For the literal leaf, select the actual allocation containing G+30 and G+3484: observe its successful allocation/birth, canonical owner/physical mapping, and same-owner free/replacement result, then bind a readable nonrepeating producer identity under lifetime protection at A0, CE0 and CE4. The existing D2AC/r31 sample selects a construction observation only; it needs the actual heap target/return and generation before deeper analysis. If payload/command reservation authority is required too, additionally select B818's actual route/grants atA3308/330C andA331C/3320, with canonical ranges and the first overlapping pool/segment/restore/release event. One observed value change does not prove complete recycling coverage; one equal candidate across proved reuse falsifies it. A0 also needs an explicit producer reservation or later grant binding for backing that does not exist yet.

replacementObligations: An owned BeginVertices returns a writable aligned guest address covering q*4 bytes, never a host-only pointer. Reserve durable device/thread/frame/generation ownership and commit/copy capacity before consumption; preserve indexed staging words and restored stride. A separate host-owned guest mapping still requires an explicit contract for every retained guest pool/list/cursor observer.

At matching EndVertices copy all geometry synchronously into immutable host-owned storage before guest backing reuse, then retain host/upload resources through real host/GPU retirement. A short decide-and-write lease is not a durable begin-to-commit token.

After consumed begin, withdrawal, wrong owner/staging, missing commit or copy/submission failure requires explicit terminal handling; Original EndVertices only publishes a cursor and cannot recover missing geometry.

Admission still requires exact dirty/stride/allocator rows, helper/alias/caller-live closure, natural paired sink/native draw coverage, full architectural parity and lifecycle/failure checks. Tiled admission additionally requires complete list/worker delivery and safe reclaim. Static samples and counters do not supply these gates.
guards: No blanket dirty-state idempotence, manager-null invariant, output omission, safe allocator reuse or runtime consume admission follows.
Keep B+4 pool progress distinct from S2+4 present acknowledgement, B+0 completed ticket, B+0x3C RPTR and N participation.
A selected entry+0 writer does not close rectangle construction, all0x89 entries,0x8A output objects, actual root activation or outside readers/free.
conclusion: Three selected direct sink continuations wrote complete80-byte quads through their actual commits. Ordered helper/allocation effects and a selected tiled command-placeholder destination were joined; actual owner generations, first safe reuse, dynamic helper effects and complete reader/delivery contracts remained the blockers to broader consumption.
